description: This file contains utility functions and classes for unlifting and manipulating Torch FX graph modules, including handling input/output specifications, guard code generation, and creating stateful graph modules for exported models.

classes.name: GuardsFn
classes.description: Module class for guard functions, used to encapsulate guard code logic.

methods.name: eq_spec
methods.description: Refines TreeSpec.__eq__ to match structures like torch.Size(...) with tuple(...).

methods.name: _check_inputs_match
methods.description: Checks if provided args and kwargs match the expected input TreeSpec, flattening and validating structure.

methods.name: _force_ep_signature_match
methods.description: Replaces placeholder variable names in guard code to match input paths for retracing.

methods.name: _force_gm_signature_match
methods.description: Reconciles differences in guard code when exported module signature differs from unlifted graph module.

methods.name: _convert_guards_code_to_fn
methods.description: Generates a Python function from guard code strings, replacing placeholder paths with args indices.

methods.name: _check_input_constraints_for_module
methods.description: Checks input constraints for a module, ensuring inputs match expected specs.

methods.name: _check_input_constraints_pre_hook
methods.description: Pre-hook to validate input constraints before module execution.

methods.name: _unlift_inputs_as_getattr
methods.description: Replaces parameter/buffer/constants in the graph with getattr nodes for unlifted inputs.

methods.name: _insert_copy_for_mutations
methods.description: Inserts copy_ operators in the graph to reflect mutations of buffers or inputs.

methods.name: _get_codegen
methods.description: Creates code generator for the graph based on input/output specs.

methods.name: _unlift
methods.description: Unlifts a FX graph module by replacing lifted parameters with get_attr nodes and handling mutations.

methods.name: _register_attrs_to_new_gm
methods.description: Assigns parameters, buffers, and constants to a new FX GraphModule based on a signature.

methods.name: _create_stateful_graph_module
methods.description: Creates a stateful FX GraphModule with hooks and constants properly registered.

methods.name: _get_input_paths
methods.description: Generates paths of input placeholders for guard code generation.

methods.name: _replace_sources
methods.description: Replaces placeholder variable names in guard strings with user paths.

methods.name: _get_input_guards_for_graph
methods.description: Generates guard code for input constraints, including shape and range checks.

methods.name: _unlift_exported_program_lifted_states
methods.description: Replaces lifted parameters in an exported program with get_attr nodes, creates guard functions, and returns an unlifted FX module.
